noPermission.applyForTenantAdmin: Ask your administrator for tenant administrator permissions (tenant-admin)
noPermission.note: Note: permission approval is only the first step. Step 1: Ask your administrator for `ws-admin` or `tenant-admin` permissions. Step 2: Once approved, contact the workspace administrator to assign you the corresponding role. The permission alone does not automatically enable the functionality.
